dashboard.label: TA-disk Overview
dashboard.description: Collects disk health from smartctl (SATA/ATA SMART + NVMe) and /sys/class/nvme: health status, power-on hours, temperature, NVMe wear (percentage used, available spare), media

search.query: index=main sourcetype="disk:status" | stats latest(_time) as "Last seen", count as Reports by host | table host "Last seen" Reports
| mcatalog values(metric_name) as m where index=metrics metric_name="disk.*" | eval count=mvcount(m)
index=main sourcetype="disk:status" _raw="*alarm*" | sort - _time | table _time host _raw | rename _raw as Event | head 200
